modules.name: Lunar50Drone
modules.description: 5-oscillator sawtooth drone VCO with per-oscillator frequency knobs, a shared CV input, and a CV attenuverter

modules.name: LunarLFO
modules.description: Dual unipolar triangle/square LFO (slow A, fast B) with a brightness LED per LFO

modules.name: LunarVCO
modules.description: AS3340-style VCO with 6 waveforms (4 fixed + 2 morphing via shape), octave/sub/lin-exp switches, hard sync, and a full ADSR envelope with Hold and Self-generation

modules.name: LunarPapaSrapa
modules.description: Noise voice inspired "Papa Srapa" drone voice: FM/AM cross-modulated square oscillators, independent white noise, sample & hold, and an Attack/Release envelope with Hold
